preheader: One decision before release: keep the current retry limit or increase it?
title: One call before release.
body: The checkout fix is ready. There is one remaining tradeoff: how long to wait for a slow payment provider before showing a retry message.
question: Keep the current retry limit?

options.label: Keep two attempts
options.detail: Preserves the current wait time. A small number of slow payments will need a manual retry.

options.label: Allow three attempts
options.detail: Recovers more slow payments, but can add five seconds before the customer sees a result.

recommendation: Keep two attempts for this release. We can revisit the limit with a week of production timing data.
reply_hint: Reply with A or B, or describe another approach. The release will wait for your decision.
